issues.legal_issue: An operating agency selling assets of a sick industrial company must obtain a valuation report and determine and disclose the reserve price before initiating the sale process.
A public auction lacking competitive bidding cannot secure the optimum realizable value, and an accepted sole bid may be set aside when the sale process is defective.
A successful bidder must comply with the auction guidelines requiring a bank guarantee and timely payment of the purchase consideration.
Persons directly affected by the sale and interested in the property may challenge confirmation of the auction sale under Article 226 even if they did not participate in the bidding.
A higher offer made after the bidding process has concluded does not, by itself, have legal significance or entitle the offeror to purchase the property.
